subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: After identifying the exact commit that fixed explicit-session Ollama compaction, should it ship through the next normal release or receive a bounded v2026.7.x backport?
rationale: The technical failure no longer reproduces on current main, but the latest stable release remains affected and release/backport policy cannot be inferred from source behavior alone.

options.title: Next normal release
options.body: Identify the fixing commit, verify the fresh-process regression test, and keep this issue open until that commit ships in the next normal release.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Cherry-pick the narrow provider-stream fix and regression coverage if stable users need an earlier patch release.

options.title: Close before shipping
options.body: Close as current-main-only once exact provenance is known, accepting that stable users must wait without a tracked release target.

recommendation.title: Next normal release
recommendation.body: Identify the fixing commit, verify the fresh-process regression test, and keep this issue open until that commit ships in the next normal release.

likelyOwner.reason: This person was routed as a likely contact for the affected area, but the actual release owner should confirm or redirect the decision.
